trades.thesis: Pre-market gap of about +5% (IEX 137.26 vs 129.85 close) that looks like an earnings beat, after a 6-day losing streak and -11% over 20 days. HD and LOW are down pre-market, so the move is stock-specific. Relief gap plus post-earnings drift in a $140B quality retailer. Price/volume only, cause not verified. Stop sits near the pre-gap close (gap fill).

extensions.thesis: Post-earnings gap held for 6 sessions. Every close since 11/18 is above 139 and the post-gap lows are 137.0 to 137.4, with 11/24 closing at 143.86 near the high (+3.3%, retail read-across from BURL, ROST, DKS, ANF). Stop trailed to about 135.5, under the post-gap lows, to protect the gain. Target kept near 149.3. Price/volume only.
